full_prompt:
Draw exactly ONE new Small Seal glyph U+3D06F.
Use EVERY available THX, CCZ, QJZ, DYC witness equally to identify this ONE Small Seal character. Select one coherent attested whole construction where connections differ; never blend incompatible variants or substitute modern Chinese. Output exactly ONE complete newly drawn sans-serif/Gothic glyph in black strokes on transparent alpha, central70% square canvas, no labels/reference copies/grid/backdrop. Real smooth continuous stroke trajectories, uniform width approximately3%canvas, round caps and joins, no calligraphic pressure or texture.
CRITICAL PLACEMENT AND STROKE READING:
1. All FOUR historical witnesses compared. Correct the LEFT component's VERTICAL PLACEMENT: its TOP horizontal must align at approximately the RIGHT U-CUP FLOOR, and its BASE horizontal must align with the RIGHT OVAL'S INTERNAL DIVIDER, or only slightly below that divider. Never place its top bar down at the chevron apex.
2. Left compact motif is three horizontal bars joined by one vertical from top to baseline, near-even bar gaps, upper/bottom bars longer than middle. Height about40–45% of full right component. Example canvas y-anchors: left top29%,middle42.5%,baseline56%, with right cup floor29% and oval divider56–57%. These relationships are essential.
3. Right TOP is open U-cup with two upward side tips and a HIGHER central vertical tip, exactly THREE tips. Central stem descends through U-floor and forks into TWO large upper chevron shoulders.
4. Exactly TWO SHORT DETACHED slashes above those large chevron shoulders: left rising, right falling, both separate from cup/stem/shoulders. Do not merge either small slash with a larger arm.
5. Below upper chevron, one fully DETACHED rounded oval with ONE horizontal divider creates exactly TWO counters. Clear air gap separates chevron and oval; no triangle counter above oval. Choose coherent detached attested whole form.
6. At oval bottom, central stem descends and forks into TWO long outward-curving lower legs. Another TWO short detached slashes flank this lower stem, left and right, above/outside lower fork. Exactly FOUR short detached slash marks overall, all visible and free at both ends.
7. Preserve compact left motif, three upper tips, four detached slashes, two separate oval counters, large upper chevron and lower two-leg fork. Thin constant-width rounded technical-pen courses, no brush taper.
The LEFT motif must sit HIGHER: TOP BAR LEVEL WITH U-CUP FLOOR; BOTTOM BAR LEVEL WITH OVAL DIVIDER. This relation is shared by all four references. Preserve every right-side course, especially FOUR detached short diagonal marks and TWO oval counters; no missing branches.
